synth.notes:
Click (ACTION6) hit-tests objects by bbox and dispatches on type.
tile: clicking it toggles its color tag color_14 <-> color_15.
operator: clicking it toggles its own marker_14/15 and the tiles one 8-cell step away up, down, left or right. Glyphs are left alone.
glyph, empty-cell clicks and actions other than 6 do nothing. Stateless.
Not confirmed: whether operators also flip neighbouring operators or glyphs, and what actions 1-5/7 do (never observed).
